 December Social Security direct payment worth $994 goes out in 27 days
 By Britta Miller 
 Published
 November 4, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The December 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in 27 days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month. The program supports people with limited income who are blind, age 65 or older, or have another qualifying disability.
